verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS back-office and compliance platform with a dashboard and API integrations, so user-defined event automation is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only vendor-run automations: automatic nexus monitoring, automated filings and tax payments, and continuous book reconciliation. Nothing shows users can define their own rules or triggers that fire actions on events, so this is adjacent behavior, not the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
